items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This other T-Boy Rene... was he in the Eureka band? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he played in the Eureka band.

ctx.x: Kid Rene. Yeah, Kid Rene. This other T-Boy Rene, a similar name, at that time was he in the Eureka band? When I heard him, he was in the Eureka band. T-Boy. T-Boy, that was quite late though. I just wondered...
Yeah, he played in the Eureka band. During the years that you played with him too?
